newsitem.title: FRANCE: Total in talks for Nigeria oil contract.
newsitem.headline: Total in talks for Nigeria oil contract.

text.p: A spokesman for French oil company Total SA said on Monday it was in talks with the Nigerian authorities to offer technical assistance for the northern oil refinery at Kaduna.
"We are still in negotiations. No contract has been signed," the spokesman told Reuters. "The negotiations are on the right track."
The French company made an offer for "technical assistance to the Nigerian authorities at the beginning of July" and this is currently being studied, he said.

The Kaduna refinery, which has installed capacity of 110,000 barrels per day, was shut down for repairs at the end of July, Nigerian newspapers reported. They did not say how long the closure would last.
Nigeria suffers from frequent bouts of fuel shortage, despite producing more than two million barrels of crude oil per day. Its four refineries suffer from poor maintenance.
